Commentary.Commentary: The chase is set to begin. The Bangladesh players are seen to be in a huddle. They are getting some parting words from Shakib Al Hasan. They are followed by the opening pair of Jatinder Singh and Aqib Ilyas, who walk out to bat for Oman. Taskin Ahmed to start with the ball.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then. 154 is what Oman need to win and confirm their place in the Super 12 and with the backing of the home crowd, they will be pumped and excited to come out and chase this down. Bangladesh need a win to stay alive and they have the bowling attack required to defend this total. Will they be able to do so though? We shall find out. Stay tuned for Oman's reply.

Fayyaz Butt (4-0-30-3) is up for a chat. The pacer says that it is a very big thing for him and his team also to make a debut in this tournament. Regarding his first wicket, Butt replies that he bowled three good-length deliveries, all slower ones and then bowled with extra pace to dismiss the batsman. Tells that he admires Imran Khan and Brett Lee a lot, and they are legends. Shares that he played Under-19 World Cup for Pakistan and at that time, his action was different.

A good bowling display from the hosts, but they know that they could have done slightly better, especially out on the field, as they dropped a bucketload of catches, which they would hope does not come back to haunt them. The start by them was top-notch, but they found it hard to break the stand between Naim and Shakib. Once that stand was dismantled, they bounced back well towards the end. Bilal Khan had a fruitful evening as both his spells, at the start and the end, were fearsome and he ended with figures of 4-0-18-3. Fayyaz Butt led the charge as he ended with 3 to his name and Kaleemullah reaped rewards too with his 2 scalps.

This batting display of Bangladesh was only about 2 batters and nobody else. Yes, Mahmudullah did well towards the end by getting a few handy runs, but if not for the knocks by Mohammad Naim and Shakib Al Hasan, the Bangla Tigers would have been staring down the barrel. They started off poorly as they could only conjure 29 runs, losing 2 wickets, in the Powerplay. Then, came the stand of substance between Naim and Shakib of 80 runs, which helped the Tigers get the push. Lady luck smiled on them as Oman dropped a few catches too. Once this stand was broken, Bangladesh fell from 101/2 to 122/6. After that, the Bangla skipper hit a couple of boundaries but they never found the final burst.

Oman will definitely be the happier of the two sides at the halfway stage of this game, but, had they stopped Bangladesh to a total of around 20 runs lesser, then the game would be in their grasp. Their counterparts though, with the exception of a couple of batters, never got going and have ended on a decent total of 153.

OUT! Bangladesh are all out on the final ball! Bilal Khan delivers it full and on middle, Mustafizur Rahman hops back to make room for a big shot but only manages to tower it high in the air towards mid off. Zeeshan Maqsood gets underneath it, keeps his eyes on the ball and takes the skier safely. Bangladesh have got 153 on the board.
Commentary.Howout: c Zeeshan Maqsood b Bilal Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Very full and in the line of the stumps, Mustafizur Rahman digs it out from the inner half of his bat and it squirts behind square leg. The batsmen get two.
Short and around off, Mustafizur Rahman steps back and then tries to play a late cut but fails to connect.

OUT! STUMPS SHATTERED! Bilal Khan switches to 'round the wicket and spears in a very full ball around off at 129 kph, Mahmudullah stays back to swing his bat at it but fails to connect. The ball goes behind to peg the off stump back. Bilal has two in the match, can Oman get Bangladesh all out?

Well stopped at extra cover by Zeeshan Maqsood! Fuller and around off, Taskin drives it through the line but fails to get it past the Oman skipper. They cross for a run and Mahmudullah is back on strike.
Mustafizur Rahman is the last man in!
Four leg byes! Wrong line from Bilal Khan, fuller and around middle, angling down the leg side, Taskin tries to flick but misses. It clips his pads and speeds away to the fine leg fence. 150 up!

FOUR! That fumble from the keeper has cost his team a boundary in the end. Short and outside off, Mahmudullah camps back and steers it through the gap between short third man and backward point. 6 balls left, how many more can Bangladesh add to their total?
Sharp one, short and around off, Taskin Ahmed tries to pull but misses. The keeper fumbles and concedes a bye.
Bilal Khan (3-0-15-1) to bowl the final over of the innings!
Short and wide, outside off, change in pace again, Mahmudullah chops his attempted square cut, towards short third man, and takes a single.

On a length around middle and leg, Mahmudullah clips it behind square leg and the ball races away. The fielder in the deep does well to pull it back before the fence and after consulting the third umpire, the onfield umpire is happy with the fielding effort. Two runs added to the total.

OUT! Fayyaz Butt has two in two and Bangladesh are falling apart at the death. Once again it's a short delivery, slower in pace and around off, Mohammad Saifuddin steps back and tries to slap it through the line. But it takes the top half of his blade and flies down to Jatinder Singh at long off. He celebrates yet another catch by doing a thigh-five! Fayyaz Butt on a hat-trick...
Commentary.Howout: c Jatinder Singh b Fayyaz Butt

Commentary.Commentary: Taskin Ahmed is in!

OUT! Caught behind! Second wicket in the match for Butt and he thanks his stars. He hurls across a short delivery outside off slower in pace, Rahim goes on his toes to play his little dab shot down to third man but the ball bounces a bit extra to take the outside edge. Naseem Khushi makes no mistake and Bangladesh lose another wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Naseem Khushi b Fayyaz Butt

Commentary.Commentary: Who walks in? Mohammad Saifuddin.
Wide! Fayyaz Butt tries to bowl a slower one but delivers it way wide outside off, Rahim lets it go and the umpire stretches his arms.
Fuller and around off, Rahim drives it to extra cover and scoots to the other end as the fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end. 10 from the over! Can Bangladesh get to 160 from here?
Slower one, short and around off, Mahmudullah pulls it away to deep mid-wicket for a single.

SIX! Mahmudullah has thumped this one! Bangladesh need many more of these shots. Back of a length, on middle and leg, the Bangla skipper rides the bounce and muscles it behind square leg for a biggie. 75m on the radar. The ball is to be sanitized and hence there is a slight delay.
Oman won't mind singles at this stage. Short in length and outside off, slower in pace, Rahim moves back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Very full and around off, a bit of wristwork from Mahmudullah as he flicks it through square leg for a single.
Swing and a miss! Mohammad Nadeem delivers it on a length and outside off, Mahmudullah steps down the track, a premeditated charge, swings his bat at it but fails to connect.

FOUR! Rahim opens his account with a smashing boundary. Short in length and just outside off, Mushfiqur Rahim rocks back and whacks it through the gap between backward point and short third man. Ruins the over slightly. 7 runs and two wickets from it!
Mohammad Nadeem (3-0-25-0) to bowl the 18th over.
Slower again, around middle and leg, Mahmudullah works it in front of square leg for a single.

OUT! A big setback for Bangladesh as their set batsman departs in the end overs. Clever deception from Kaleemullah. He digs it in short, slower in pace around middle and off, Mohammad Naim camps back to pull but is a bit early into the shot. The ball flies to deep mid-wicket and Ayaan Khan comes running in to take an easy catch. A fine knock by Naim but his team needed him to last the distance.
Mushfiqur Rahim makes his way out now!
Change of pace again, fuller and around off, Mahmudullah drags his attempted heave to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Aerial but this one drops safely in the deep. Kaleemullah bowls a slower one, on a shortish length around off, Naim flat-bats it behind the bowler for a single as Jatinder Singh cuts it off on one bounce, running across to his left from long off.
The skipper, Mahmudullah arrives.

OUT! CAUGHT! Kaleemullah strikes to remove Afif. He delivers it full and outside off, Afif Hossain tries to smash it down the ground but fails to get the desired connection. It goes high in the air and Jatinder Singh moves across to his right from long off to catch the ball safely.
Full ball, on middle and leg, Afif Hossain hits it powerfully straight to the long on fielder for a single.  Good comeback by Bilal Khan after the six of the first ball.
Change. Kaleemullah (3-0-23-0) to bowl out now!
Short in length and on middle, Afif Hossain steps back to slam it over point but the ball bounces over his bat.

NOT OUT! Full ball, angling down the leg side, Afif Hossain looks to flick it away but misses. There is some sound as it goes to the keeper and they appeal. The umpire is not interested. Oman go for a late review but the UltraEdge confirms that there is no bat and the sound was from the ball brushing the pads.
Perfect yorker, outside off. Afif Hossain looks to dig it out but misses.
Fuller, on middle and leg, Mohammad Naim drills it to long on for a single.
DRS! A late call for a review for caught behind by Oman. UltraEdge shows a flatline as the ball passes the bat and only brushed the pad, on the way to the keeper. Not out, it is.
SIX! Out of the park! Length ball, on off, Mohammad Naim lofts it over long on as his one hand comes off. Biggie.

OUT! Nurul Hasan departs! Fuller ball, on off, Nurul Hasan gets under it and looks to go big straight down the ground. Gets the elevation but fails to get enough distance on that one. Sandeep Goud at long off settles under it and takes a fine catch in the end.
Commentary.Howout: c Sandeep Goud b Zeeshan Maqsood

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, on the leg stump line, Naim drills it to long on for a single.
Fuller, on the stumps, Mohammad Naim reverse-sweeps it towards sweeper cover for a couple.
Afif Hossain is the new man in!
Fuller again, Mohammad Naim smashes it again straight but this time straight to the bowler.
FOUR! Fifty for Mohammad Naim! Full ball, on middle and leg, Naim clears his front leg and smashes it straight back past the bowler for a boundary.
Back of a length, outside off, Nurul eases it past backward point for a single.

Another chance of a run out! It was super close! Short and outside off, Hasan taps it towards point. Naim calls him for a single. Aqib Ilyas collects the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses this time. Nurul Hasan puts in a dive to get inside the crease safely.

A length ball, on off. Hasan works it away towards wide long on. The batters take two with ease and Butt is not happy with that. Although, the replays show there was a short run as Mohammad Naim didn't complete the first run properly. Bangladesh only get a single in the end.
Good length and outside off, Naim hangs back and slashes it through cover-point. The batters take a single with ease. There was a second run on the cards, as the keeper fumbled but he had a backup.

OUT! RUN OUT! Oman needed some inspiration in the field and Aqib Ilyas, the man with the golden arm, provides his side with a breakthrough. A near-yorker around off. Shakib Al Hasan hangs back and digs it out to backward point. Naim calls for a single and Shakib Al Hasan takes off. Aqib Ilyas collects the ball and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end. Shakib Al Hasan was not even in the frame when the replays rolled in. This is what Oman were hunting for, the 80-run stand has been broken.
In walks Nurul Hasan.
Back of a length, outside off, Naim works it towards third man off the bottom end of the blade. The batters take a single.
On a length, around middle and off. Naim hangs back and pulls it towards deep square leg for a couple.
Full and on the pads, Naim looks to flick it away but misses. The batters cross as the keeper has not collected it. 10 runs coming off this over.
Fayyaz Butt (2-0-16-1) is back on.
Flatter and on middle, Shakib Al Hasan goes back and pushes it to covers. He takes off for a quick single.
On the pads, Naim tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played by Naim. Quicker, full and outside off, Naim comes across and reverse-hits it towards third man for a boundary.
Tossed up, outside off, Shakib Al Hasan hangs back and slaps it to long off for a run.
Short and outside off, Shakib Al Hasan stays back and hits it wide of long off for a couple.
Play and a miss! Dot ball to end the over! Full, outside off, Mohammad Naim goes chasing for that but misses. Still, a very productive over for Bangladesh, 17 coming off it.
Change. The skipper, Zeeshan Maqsood brings himself on now!
Cheeky this time! Fuller, on the stumps, Mohammad Naim gets across and paddle-scoops it over the fielder at short fine leg for a couple.
SIX! Both the batters are getting the boundaries now at regular intervals. Short ball, at a comfortable height for Naim, he rocks back and pulls it powerfully over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
On a length, on middle, Shakib Al Hasan works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Length ball, on the pads line, Shakib Al Hasan pulls it to backward square leg for another boundary. Shakib is turning it on here now for Bangladesh.

FOUR! The runs are flowing now for Bangladesh. Good use of the feet from Shakib Al Hasan. A full-length ball, on middle and leg. Shakib Al Hasan skips down the track and smacks it down the ground for a boundary, past mid off.
Shorter and around off, Shakib steps down the track but is deceived in flight, somehow manages to send it down to long on for a run. The 50-run stand comes up!
Fuller again, Shakib Al Hasan drives it back past the bowler, wide of long on and collects a couple.
Flatter and shorter, around middle and leg and skidding back in, Shakib steps back to cut but is cramped for room and ends up bottom-edging it on the pitch.
FOUR! Fuller, on off, Shakib Al Hasan leans forward and lifts it delightfully over covers for a boundary. He was looking to play this shot for quite some time and has finally nailed one.
Flatter, shorter, outside off, Mohammad Naim looks to cut but misses. Naseem Khushi misses too and the batters take a bye as the ball rolls behind the keeper.
Fuller, outside off, Naim drives it to the fielder at covers in the ring.

A couple to end the over! A length ball, on off. Shakib Al Hasan gets under it and lifts it over mid off. The fielder chases it but the ball lands safely in front of him. The batters take two in the end. 18 runs coming off the last two overs. Good signs for Bangladesh.
A touch short around middle and leg, Mohammad Naim turns inside the crease and pulls it over square leg for another single.

Drinks! Oman started off really well by choking the runs and taking a couple of quick wickets, but, since then, they have been poor on the field as they have dropped 3 catches and have allowed Shakib Al Hasan and Mohammad Naim to stitch a handy stand. Bangladesh will be hoping that these two can continue at the same rate, whereas, a couple of quick wickets is what Oman will be eyeing.
Streaky! On a length, outside off, Shakib Al Hasan swings hard at it. The ball takes the outside edge and goes wide of the keeper to third man. The batters cross for a single.
PLAY AND A MISS! Good-length ball, angling away from the batter. Shakib Al Hasan skips down the track and looks to heave it away but misses.
FOUR! Finally, Shakib Al Hasan connects with his paddle scoop. Touch fuller, on off, Shakib Al Hasan gets across and scoops it over short fine leg. The ball ends up in the boundary.
In the air...Safe! Length ball, around off. Naim looks to go over covers but does not time it well. The ball goes off the outer half but it lands safely. The batters cross for a single.
Another single and 9 runs coming off the first over of Aqib Ilyas. Full and on off, Naim eases it towards long off. Bangladesh would hope for a solid partnership between the current pair.
Change. Kaleemullah (2-0-14-0) is back to bowl his third.
Floated, around off. Shakib Al Hasan tries to drive it over covers but the ball goes towards long on off the inner half. They take another single.
Tossed up, around off. Naim stays back and pushes it to long off for another single.
Good connection this time. Full and outside off. Shakib Al Hasan leans in and slashes it towards sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Shakib Al Hasan gets going now. Touch short, around middle and leg. Shakib Al Hasan goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Loopy ball, on off. Naim hangs back and slaps it towards long on for a single.
Another play and a miss! On a length, outside off, Shakib Al Hasan swings hard across the line but misses.

DROPPED AGAIN! Short ball, Mohammad Naim pulls it straight to the mid-wicket fielder in the ring. But unfortunately for Oman, Kashyap Prajapati drops his second catch of the evening. He fires a throw in frustration at the non-striker's end but misses. The batters take a single. Oman have bowled brilliantly but have also dropped three catches in the match already.
Will skipper Zeeshan Maqsood finally bring on some spin now? Yes, he will, as Aqib Ilyas is handed the ball!
Short and wide! Mohammad Naim goes for the cut off the back foot but misses.
On a length, outside off, Shakib Al Hasan steers it towards third man for a single.
Play and a miss! A length ball, outside off. The ball moves away a shade. Shakib Al Hasan looks to chase it but misses.
A single now! A slower, full-length ball, on off. Naim pushes it through covers. The batters take a single, as the throw from the fielder running in restricted the pair.
WIDE! Nadeem starts this over with a loosener. A length ball, sliding down leg. Naim leaves it alone. Wide called by the umpire.
Full ball, on off, Mohammad Naim drives it to mid off for a single. Retains the strike. 12 from the over.

DROPPED AND SIX! Fayyaz Butt cannot believe it. Back of a length, outside off, Mohammad Naim jumps and slaps it aerially over covers. Jatinder Singh, running to his left in the deep, tries to catch it with his fingers pointing up. It bursts through his fingers and Singh ends up parrying it over the fence. Costly miss.
Fuller, around off, Mohammad Naim drives it powerfully through covers and gets two.

Uppish but safe! Short ball, on off, this time. Shakib Al Hasan goes deep in his crease and pulls it. Fails to time it properly and the ball goes to the deep square leg fielder on one bounce for a single. Fayyaz Butt got very excited for a moment.
On a length, again, around off, Mohammad Naim steers it towards third man for a single.
Back of a length, on off, Shakib works it away in front of square leg for a single.
Fullish and around off, Shakib pushes it to mid off. The fielder is at the edge of the circle and hence it's an easy run. At the end of the Powerplay, Bangladesh are 29/2.
Again a bit of an extra bounce, around middle, Naim goes on his toes to defend but gets an inside edge. It rolls wide of the stumps on the leg side and they cross for a single.
A hint of movement, around middle and leg, Shakib tucks it down to backward square leg and collects a single.
Nadeem lands this one on a length outside off, Shakib gets into an awkward position as he possibly tries to premeditate a paddle scoop. He is forced to change his mind and defend it to the off side.

Excellent delivery, shortish and on middle, shaping in to cramp the batsman for room, Naim goes back to deal with it. The ball bounces a bit extra, takes his gloves and rolls towards square leg. They cross.
A bit on the shorter side around off, Naim plays it down with soft hands towards cover-point and looks for a run. He is sent back.
Fuller and on off, angling in, Shakib drives it back to the bowler. Eventful over from Fayyaz Butt.
Bowling change. Mohammad Nadeem to bowl now!
Fullish and on off, shaping in, Shakib pushes it back to the bowler off the inner half. Butt dives to his left and stops the ball partially.

FOUR! Streaky! Shakib Al Hasan opens his account with a boundary. Not what he was looking to do but he will accept this. A full toss, around off, Shakib Al Hasan lines up to drive this away but he gets a thick outside edge and the ball runs away to the third man fence.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! The move to promote Mahedi Hasan has not worked for Bangladesh. Slightly short in length around off, at 136 kph, it's not short enough to pull but Mahedi stands back to do that. He swings his bat across the line but the ball skids on sharply at him and takes the splice of his blade. The ball lobs back to the bowler and Fayyaz Butt does well to accept the return catch with a dive to his left. Outstanding effort and his teammates are mobbing him. Bangladesh are in a spot of bother.
Who will come out? Shakib Al Hasan, it is.
Identical to the last delivery, this time Mahedi plays a bit late and pushes it with an angled bat to point.

What a delivery! That beat the outside edge by a whisker. Fayyaz Butt speeds in and serves it on a length outside off, skidding away off the surface, Mahedi tries to push at it but it whistles past the edge.
Close to off, on a good length, Naim is not happy with himself as he ends up pushing it back to the bowler. 10 from the over!
Will Bilal Khan continue with the ball? Nopes. Fayyaz Butt is introduced into the attack.
Much better line and length from the bowler. Angles across a length ball, outside off, Naim tries to drive it through the line, a loose effort away from the body, and he misses.

SIX! Mohammad Naim is turning it on now for Bangladesh. Kaleemullah delivers it around middle and leg, on a length, Naim clears his front leg and heaves it all the way over mid-wicket for a maximum. Clean strike.

FOUR! Width offered and Naim latches onto it. Short and around off, angling away, Naim hangs on the back foot and smacks it square of the wicket on the off side. No chance for the fielder in the deep.
Around middle and off, on a length again, this time the batsman defends it back to the bowler.
On a length and around off, Mohammad Naim defends it from the crease to the off side.
Very full again, around off and swinging back in, Hasan defends it out to end a successful over for Bilal.

OUT! LBW! A toe-crusher from Bilal Khan yet again, around middle and curling back in a bit, Das tries his best to dig it out but misses. He is rapped on the pads, they appeal but the finger stays down. Oman are reviewing it. The UltraEdge confirms that there is no bat and the Ball Tracker shows three reds. Crashing onto the stumps. Das' stay is over and the hosts are delighted.
Mahedi Hasan gets a promotion in the batting order.

DROPPED! Liton Das gets a life. Bilal Khan delivers it on a length around middle, Das gets forward and across to flick it aerially over backward square leg. Kashyap Prajapati speeds across to his right in the deep, reaches the ball as well but fails to grab it cleanly. They take two runs.
Fractionally short and around off, it's defended from the back foot to the off side.

Review time! Now, a review is taken by Oman for an LBW appeal against Liton Das! Replays show that the ball hit the pad first. A great review as the Ball Tracker shows THREE REDS. That is the end of Das!
Fullish and angling in around middle, Naim heaves it to deep square leg for a single.

Plenty of action on this delivery. A lovely yorker around off, Das walks forward to take it on the full and digs it out with his bat and pad together. The ball deflects to point, the bowler appeals and the fielder scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end. The ball now ricochets away towards mid on and they cross for a run. Given as a run, so it was bat first.
Shortish and outside off, it's guided down to third man for a single.
Back of a length around off, Liton Das punches it to cover-point where the fielder fumbles and concedes two runs.

DAS IS SAFE! A peach of a delivery though by Kaleemullah. He dishes it on a good length and lands it close to off, Liton Das shows no footwork as he has a gentle poke inside the line. The ball whizzes past the outside edge and the keeper appeals after collecting it. The finger has gone up but Das is quick to take the DRS. The UltraEdge confirms that not just the footwork of the batsman but the edge of the bat is also missing. No spike. Das survives.

On a length around off, angling away, Naim taps it down to backward point and that fielder has a needless shy at the bowler's end. He misses and the backup fielder also fails to collect the ball. They cross for an overthrow.
Review time! Liton Das has been given out for caught behind and he takes the review straightaway. UltraEdge detects no spike when the ball passes the bat and hence, the decision has been overturned.
Play and a miss! Short and wide outside off, Naim flashes his bat at it but fails to connect.
Kaleemullah starts with a delivery on middle and off, a touch short, Naim defends it back to the bowler.
Back of a length on off, Mohammad Naim runs it down to third man and opens his account with a single. A tidy first over by Bilal.
Wide! A bit harsh on the bowler. On a shortish length again, outside off and shaping away, Naim chases and misses. That ball was flirting with the tramline and the umpire gives it a wide.
Shortish and outside off, it's played down from the crease to point.
Who bowls from the other end? It is Kaleemullah.

Wide! Bangladesh open their account. Bilal Khan probably tries bowling an inswinger but fails to get the line right. It's drifting down the leg side, Naim tries to flick but misses. The keeper collects and appeals but the umpire turns to signal for a wide.
Four dots on the trot. Fuller and wider outside off, Mohammad Naim plays a confident drive but again finds the fielder at short cover.
Fuller on middle and off, shaping away a shade, Naim drives but straight to the short cover fielder.
Another outswinger is served by Bilal Khan. The line is closer to off this time and Naim defends it from the crease to the off side.
A gentle delivery to begin proceedings. It's an outswinger on a length outside off, Naim watches it well and makes a leave.

The game is set to begin. Firstly the players come out for their respective national anthems. First, it will be of Bangladesh and that will be followed by the anthem of the home side, Oman. Now, the Oman players spread out to their respective fielding positions and they are followed by the opening pair of Bangladesh, Mohammad Naim and Liton Das. Bilal Khan to start with the ball for the hosts.

Pitch report - Danny Morrison says that the surface has a nice tinge of grass and there is a little indentation. Adds that there could be some variable bounce and if the bowlers hit the right lines and lengths, they could do well.

The Oman skipper, Zeeshan Maqsood, says that they are happy to bowl first and they would look to keep Bangladesh to a low score. On being asked if there is any pressure on them, as, if they win this game, they could more or less confirm their place in the Super 12, Zeeshan replies that they had pressure in the first game and not in this one. Informs that they have one change, Fayyaz Butt is in for Khawar Ali.

The captain of Bangladesh, Mahmudullah, says that they will bat first. He says that they would like to put runs on the board and then defend it later on. He adds that dew is a factor here and they just want to put a good total on the board. About the last game, Mahamudullah explains that they didn’t get enough partnerships with the bat and the batters need to take more responsibility. He mentions that there is one change, Soumya Sarkar is out and Mohammad Naim replaces him.

Oman (Playing XI) - Aqib Ilyas, Jatinder Singh, Zeeshan Maqsood (C), Kashyap Prajapati, Naseem Khushi (WK), Mohammad Nadeem, Ayaan Khan, Sandeep Goud, Kaleemullah, Bilal Khan, Fayyaz Butt (In for Khawar Ali).

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Liton Das, Mohammad Naim (In for Soumya Sarkar), Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim, Mahmudullah (C), Afif Hossain, Nurul Hasan (WK), Mahedi Hasan, Mohammad Saifuddin, Taskin Ahmed, Mustafizur Rahman.
Toss - Up goes the coin, Mahmudullah calls correctly and BANGLADESH ELECT TO BAT!
Update - Scotland have secured maximum points after thumping Papua New Guinea by 17 runs. With that, they move to the top in Group B with 2 wins.

Oman made a huge statement in their tournament opener by thumping PNG by 10 wickets and have made their case really strong. Another win here will almost seal the deal for them and the home team would be looking forward to achieving that at Bangladesh's cost. The Bangla Tigers were the favourites of this group but an unexpected defeat has hurt their campaign. Losing against Scotland would have been demoralizing and that was mainly due to a disappointing batting effort. Can they pull up their socks and put up a big show?

Welcome to everyone for this vital Group B clash between Oman and Bangladesh. The former are heading into this match after an emphatic victory while the latter were shocked in their opener and find themselves precariously placed.
